goal: Participant-owned continuation from paid generated outputs and own paid-read consequences, with unchanged supplied need and automatic selection.

scope.legacy: No changes to Population, its v2/v3 schemas, selectors, recipes, prices, or baseline.

contract.inputs: Start with supplied accessible refs. Only after completed successful native work replace accessible with its exact owned retained binding; for material work wait for inherited own-event delivery and successful paid feedback read, then use that exact observation. Failed/cancelled/absent outputs keep the prior accessible tuple. No fabricated outputs or authoring after setup. All other request fields and supplied need remain fixed. Public/social handoff is not credited in this first split.
contract.scheduler: Inherit round-robin budget and repetition behavior unchanged. The continuation adapter supplies only the owned accessible refs; selector chooses route. Checkpoint stores legacy population state and exact per-episode input history; exact restore validates history before continuing.

panel.initial_content: One clearly authored hypothetical maintenance intention and paid supplied need, device and stock. No route instructions. Anticipated Theorize→Apply→Embody is a falsifiable expectation, never passed to the selector.

acceptance: Three paid completed native transformations and two exact generated-result/observed-consequence handoffs in generated-chain
Actual care changes material wear; paid-read observed consequence changes retained personal readiness; fixed paid downstream personal query can use it
Withholding the generated handoff preserves producer work/cost but changes subsequent choice or usable outcome; normal continuation auditor rejects its claimed provenance
Interrupted restored execution equals uninterrupted engine and continuation checkpoint bytes
Finite turn budget stays pending rather than claiming completion; finite wallet exhaustion or failed work preserves charges and no replenishment
Legacy population tests remain unchanged and pass
Independent raw auditor imports no scheduler, selector, executor or fixture builder; reconstructs episode inputs, fairness, charges and native semantics; forged history rejected
Freeze before acceptance, compare every source hash after execution, preserve failed/source-changed attempts
exclusions: No Phase 7 or inherited contract change
No new goal formation, replenishment, growing population or unrestricted meanings
